featured.description:
### Our Halloween Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**!  

  The event takes place on the **31st October 2026** at **17:00 UTC!**  

---

   ### **Information** 
   
   We will take to the roads of ETS2 in the dead of night during the witching hour. 
   Are you brave enough to enter? Who knows what might be lurking in the shadows!  
   
   You can find all the details via our [Blog Post](link)  
   
   ### :parking: | **Parking** 
   
   > You may park at any company available in **Paris** with a **no collision zone**. 
   
   ![Convoy Route](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/40c74b71-7a64-47ba-9bc4-a65bdfab5293.avif)

featured.description:
Some of our ghosts went missing from the pumpkin farm so we think they are hiding in some of the trailers. 
   We need your help to find all seven different coloured ghosts around the area. 
   These ghosts only come out at night, so the pitch black sky will add an extra challenge to locating them! 
   Will you be the one to find them the quickest?
   But beware: the cheeky joker ghost loves to play tricks and jump around the play area. 
   Can you find him before he jumps to a new location?  

 You can find more information on our [Blog](https://truckersmp.com/blog/349)

   The event will begin on **1st of November 15:00 UTC** and you have until **1st of November 19:00 UTC** to find all the ghosts.
	 
 # You can park in any city within the play area

* All standard Arcade server rules apply unless stated below. Rules marked with an asterisk on the Official [TruckersMP rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) do not apply.

* Participants must remain inside the map boundaries, as per §2.5 - Reckless Driving.
* Participants are permitted to drive any vehicle including a truck, bus, car, or AI vehicle.
* Participants should park in any company yard in a city listed on the "playable area" map before the start of the event.

featured.name: Official ETS2 Convoy - November 2026
featured.description:
### Our Official November Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**! 👀  

> This month, we are heading to Tirana, traveling through the Balkan to end in Rijeka.

The event takes place on the **8th November 2026** at **18:00 UTC!**  


---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your time by zone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P3QHIrvSHSpH2)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38307.1791459212.jpg)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Tirana** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you to what company to park in.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121262-official-ets2-convoy-november-2026/)**!

# 🚛 🎗️ **TCCR Pink Convoy: A Journey for Her**  



## 🎗️ ABOUT THE EVENT  

This is not just a convoy.  

This October, TCCR invites you to be part of something meaningful —  
**“Pink Convoy: A Journey for Her”**  

A charity event dedicated to the fight against breast cancer,  
and a personal tribute that makes this convoy truly special.
  
This event is held **in honor of a mother** —  
a symbol of strength, love, and resilience.  

Through her story, we stand with every woman  
who has faced, is facing, or will face this battle.
  
💖 Together, we drive with purpose.  

---

## 💰 CHARITY & DONATIONS  

We are raising funds to support the fight against breast cancer.  

🎗️ **How to support:**  
  
* Donate through our official campaign link  https://www.goodcrowd.org/c/baf0jTCR   
* Share the event  
* Join the convoy and be part of the message  

All contributions help bring awareness and support to this cause.  

---

## 🎀 DONATION LEVELS  

💖 **$5 — In Memory**  
🌸 **$10 — Supporter**  
🎗️ **$25 — Pink Warrior**  
👑 **$50 — Legacy**  

Every contribution matters. Every name becomes part of this journey.  


## 🤝 PARTNERS & VTCs  

We welcome all VTCs and communities to be part of this cause.  

If your VTC would like to participate or collaborate,  
feel free to contact us.  

💖 Let’s make this convoy a united effort.  

---

---

## 📌 EVENT INFORMATION  

**📅 Date:** Sunday , October 18, 2026  
**🕒 Meetup Time:** 18:30 UTC  
**🚚 Departure Time:** 19:30 UTC 

**📍 Start Location:** Calais  (Slots)   
**🏁 Destination:** Hamburg (IA Automotive)   
  
**🌍 DLC Required:** none

---

## 📸 MEDIA & COVERAGE  

* Official screenshots will be taken

* Streaming is highly encouraged  


This convoy is more than a route.  

It is a tribute.  
A memory.  
A message of hope.  

🎗️ Join us. Drive with us.  
Drive for her.

We are back again for another year of Cancer Awareness! [Charity Discord Server](https://discord.gg/uyAPcu9kUm)



I know cancer can be really tough to fight and it's close to people's family so I went on and decided why not do my own cancer event to raise money for cancer

This is really close to me so I would like to see as many people as we can get there and show some support!

what is cancer?

Cancer is a group of diseases involving abnormal cell growth with the potential to invade or spread to other parts of the body. These contrast with benign tumors, which do not spread With more cancer research funding, Congress can help save more lives. Every major cancer breakthrough in the past 50 years can be traced back to federally funded research. More funding for cancer research means new lifesaving treatments, new ways to prevent the disease, and more lives saved.

Cancer Awareness Campaigns get people talking about cancer, reduces the stigma of the disease, and increases support for those suffering from cancer. Putting a face to cancer can help people understand the reality of a cancer diagnosis and bring home the importance of prevention in reducing each person’s overall risk.

Together we can beat cancer.
